title: 土木施工学
subtitle: Construction Works
teachers:
KIMURA Sadao
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) learn about various earthworks and their construction methods.
(2) learn about various countermeasures for soft ground and their construction methods.
(3) learn about various foundation works and their construction methods.
(4) learn about various construction machinery.
advice:
This is a basic construction works course. We will cover the following topics:

1. Earthworks: geological survey methods, embankment, cut soils, slope protection, earthwork planning.
2. Countermeasures for soft ground: water draining, earth retaining, support work.
3. Foundation works: footings, pile foundations, other foundation works.
4. Construction machinery: roles and capabilities of various machinery.

Precautions
 Students are required to actively participate in class.
 Reference documents and practice problems will be distributed to students as appropriate.
